MATHEMATICS — MOCK EXAM #14
====

GRADE: Grade 5
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. In the number 3147, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 400
   B. 10
   C. 4
   D. 40

2. Which is greater: 1/4 or 2/2? (1 mark)
   A. 1/4
   B. 2/2
   C. Cannot tell
   D. They are equal

3. Solve for x: x + 6 = 16. (1 mark)
   A. 16
   B. 10
   C. 6
   D. 11

4. Find the GCD of 43 and 55. (1 mark)
   A. 43
   B. 1
   C. 1
   D. 2

5. What is the square of 5? (1 mark)
   A. 25
   B. 26
   C. 5
   D. 10

6. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 6 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 90
   B. 21
   C. 30
   D. 42

7. In the number 3547, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 400
   B. 40
   C. 4
   D. 10

8. What is the square of 9? (1 mark)
   A. 18
   B. 82
   C. 81
   D. 9

9. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 24
   B. 12
   C. 42
   D. 36

10. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 7 cm and 24 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 31
   B. 17
   C. 27
   D. 25

11. Find the GCD of 31 and 43. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 31
   C. 1
   D. 1

12. What is √25? (1 mark)
   A. 5
   B. 25
   C. 6
   D. 12.5

13. Find the GCD of 25 and 37. (1 mark)
   A. 25
   B. 2
   C. 1
   D. 1

14. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 81
   B. 18
   C. 90
   D. 36

15. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 6x + 2
   B. 12x + 2
   C. 12x
   D. 6x

16. What is the square of 13? (1 mark)
   A. 13
   B. 170
   C. 26
   D. 169

17. Calculate 19 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 19
   B. 19.7
   C. 19.6
   D. 25

18. Find the GCD of 37 and 49. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 1
   C. 37
   D. 2

19. What is the square of 11? (1 mark)
   A. 121
   B. 22
   C. 122
   D. 11

20. What is 1/4 as a decimal? (1 mark)
   A. 2.5
   B. 0.25
   C. 0.205
   D. 0.025

21. Calculate 31 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 31
   B. 31.6
   C. 37
   D. 31.7

22. What is the square of 7? (1 mark)
   A. 7
   B. 50
   C. 14
   D. 49

23. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 48
   B. 24
   C. 156
   D. 144

24. Volume of a cube of side 3 cm is: (1 mark)
   A. 9 cm³
   B. 27 cm³
   C. 18 cm³
   D. 12 cm³

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
25. Show full working: A trader sells 18 items at Ksh 50 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

26. Show full working: A trader sells 19 items at Ksh 55 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

31. Show full working: A trader sells 16 items at Ksh 80 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

32. Show full working: A trader sells 17 items at Ksh 85 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
